summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its subsidiary YMA Corporation received Central Bank of Taiwan authorization to initiate a $60 million sovereign-backed financing framework for a $122.5 million solid-state battery manufacturing facility in Baytown, Texas. The filing is a routine disclosure of a financing milestone and project update, not a special situation. The press release provides project details and management commentary but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The 6-K is a standard current report of material information by a foreign private issuer, with no event triggering a special-situations category.
